request.style: English, Celtic ballad, clear tender female vocal, uilleann pipes, fiddle, Celtic harp, bodhran, low whistle, steady and consoling, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Before you took your first breath, before you knew the land
The One who made you, Jacob, held you in his hand
The One who formed you, Israel, will not let go of you
He gave Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba too

[Chorus]
Do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you
I have called you by name; you are mine
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you
I have called you by name; you are mine

[Verse]
When the rivers rise around you and the current pulls you down
They will not sweep you away, you will not drown
When you walk through fire, you will not be burned
The flames will not consume you, he is with you every turn

[Chorus]
Do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you
I have called you by name; you are mine
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you
I have called you by name; you are mine

[Bridge]
For I am the LORD your God
The Holy One of Israel, your Savior
You are mine, you are mine

[Outro]
I have called you by name
You are mine
